name: FatPanel
summary: FatPanel is a graphical trading panel (Expert Advisor wrapper) that provides a visual interface for creating automated trading strategies without writing code. It dispatches user interactions from chart events, timer checks, and trade events to an underlying CPanelDispatcher engine. The EA itself does not generate trading signals; it acts as a front-end control panel for strategy configuration and execution.
summary_zh: FatPanel是一个图形化交易面板EA，允许用户通过界面创建自动化交易策略而无需编写代码。它将图表事件、定时器检查和交易事件分派给底层CPanelDispatcher引擎处理。该EA本身不产生交易信号，而是作为策略配置和执行的前端控制面板。
strategy_analysis: FatPanel本质上是一个交易工具面板而非自主交易策略EA。它的核心架构通过CPanelDispatcher类将用户界面交互（OnChartEvent）、定时控制（OnTimer）和交易回调（OnTrade）分发到相应的处理模块。入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理和资金管理完全取决于用户在面板上配置的策略参数，而非EA内置的逻辑。该EA依赖EventSetTimer(1)实现每秒一次的控制循环，用于监控面板状态和策略执行。由于策略逻辑被封装在PanelDispatcher及引用的panel.ex5指标中，主文件无法体现具体的交易规则。它是一个半自动化工具，用户通过面板手动或配置式地驱动交易决策。
strategy_analysis_en: FatPanel is fundamentally a trading utility panel rather than an autonomous strategy EA. Its core architecture dispatches user interface interactions (OnChartEvent), timer-based control loops (OnTimer set to 1-second intervals), and trade callbacks (OnTrade) to the underlying CPanelDispatcher engine. Entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, and money management are entirely determined by the strategies the user configures through the panel interface, not by hardcoded logic in the EA itself. The EA relies on a 1-second timer for continuous monitoring of panel state and strategy execution. Since the actual strategy logic is encapsulated within PanelDispatcher and the referenced panel.ex5 indicator, the main source file reveals no specific trading rules or signal generation mechanisms. It functions as a semi-automated tool where users drive trading decisions through the panel either manually or via configured strategy parameters.

parameters.description_en: Timer interval in seconds for loop frequency

parameters.name: panel.ex5 (tester_indicator)
parameters.description: 策略测试器中引用的面板指标文件
parameters.description_en: Panel indicator file referenced in Strategy Tester

pros: 提供图形化界面，降低策略创建门槛，无需编程即可配置交易策略
采用事件分发架构（CPanelDispatcher），将UI交互、定时控制和交易回调解耦，结构清晰
支持OnTrade回调处理，能实时响应交易事件变化
pros_en: Provides a graphical interface that lowers the barrier to strategy creation, enabling trading strategy configuration without programming
Employs an event dispatch architecture (CPanelDispatcher) that decouples UI interaction, timer control, and trade callbacks for clean structure
Supports OnTrade callback handling for real-time response to trade event changes
cons: 核心策略逻辑完全隐藏在PanelDispatcher和panel.ex5中，无法审计实际交易逻辑和风险控制
主文件功能过于单薄，仅作为事件转发器，缺乏独立的错误处理和状态验证机制
每秒定时器循环可能带来不必要的资源消耗，且没有节流或条件触发优化
cons_en: Core strategy logic is entirely hidden within PanelDispatcher and panel.ex5, making it impossible to audit actual trading logic and risk controls
The main file is overly thin, serving only as an event forwarder with no independent error handling or state validation mechanisms
The 1-second timer loop may cause unnecessary resource consumption without throttling or conditional trigger optimization
improvements: 在主文件中添加初始化状态检查和错误处理，确保PanelDispatcher成功初始化后再进入运行循环
将固定1秒定时器改为可配置参数，或根据市场状态动态调整检查频率以优化性能
improvements_en: Add initialization state checks and error handling in the main file to ensure PanelDispatcher successfully initializes before entering the run loop
Make the fixed 1-second timer configurable or dynamically adjust the check frequency based on market state to optimize performance

risk_points: 核心交易逻辑封装在不可审计的PanelDispatcher类和panel.ex5指标中，用户无法验证内置风险管理
缺少对PanelDispatcher初始化失败的检测，若init()失败可能导致后续control()调用异常
risk_points_en: Core trading logic is encapsulated in unauditable PanelDispatcher class and panel.ex5 indicator, preventing users from verifying built-in risk management
No detection of PanelDispatcher initialization failure; if init() fails, subsequent control() calls may cause exceptions

The EA itself does not generate trading signals; it acts as a front-end control panel for strategy configuration and execution.
